title: unified-rollouts-proactive-shadow-canary-autorollback-workflow
author: Asha Patel
release_notes: Adds proactive shadow-canary autorollout workflow with composite metric evaluation, staged quarantine, and observability hooks. Includes e2e tests and updated runbook.
description: Motivation: Improve safety and detection for model rollouts by introducing a proactive shadow-canary autorollback workflow that automatically probes candidate models with staged shadow traffic, evaluates composite metrics (latency, error-rate, quality regressions), and quarantines/unrolls when thresholds are breached. This PR implements the controller changes, routing hooks, metric aggregator, and the quarantine stage used by the autorollback engine. Design summary: 1) Probing scheduler: proactively probes candidate variants with a small percentage of real traffic as shadow requests, ramping weight according to a configurable schedule. 2) Composite metric evaluator: combines latency p95, token-error-rate, and quality signals from evaluations (optional) into a single decision score with configurable weights. 3) Quarantine/staged rollback: if a quorum of probe windows exceed thresholds the rollout enters a quarantine stage that isolates traffic and gradually reduces weight with automatic rollback if problems persist. 4) Observability: per-rollout metric series, tracing hooks, and rollout-level dashboards plus additional logs for quarantine decisions. 5) Controls: new rollout spec fields (probeSchedule, compositeMetricWeights, quarantinePolicy, safetyGuards) with sensible defaults and opt-outs. Changes in this PR: - services/rollout-controller: add proactive probe scheduler, state machine updates for 'probing' and 'quarantine' states, and autorollback decision logic. - runtime/routing: add shadow routing path and weight manager with backward-compatible API. - pkg/metrics: composite metric aggregator and new metrics (rollout_probe_window, rollout_quarantine_count, rollout_decision_score). - e2e-tests/rollouts: add deterministic e2e tests that simulate probe failures, partial regressions, and recovery scenarios. - docs/runbooks/rollouts.md: updated runbook and guidance for tuning probeSchedule and compositeMetricWeights. - api/v1/rollouts.proto: spec additions for probe and quarantine fields. Checklist: [x] Controller implementation [x] Routing + runtime changes [x] Composite metric aggregator [x] Unit tests + integration tests [x] E2E tests covering rollback and recovery [x] Docs and runbook updates [x] Observability/dashboards smoke tested Testing notes: initial CI run showed an intermittent integration-e2e failure related to timing in the probe scheduler; adjusted probe window alignment and re-ran. CI summary: unit-tests: pass; integration-e2e: pass (after rerun); lint: pass; benchmark-lab: warn (small tail latency bump in a synthetic micro-benchmark, within acceptable threshold). Safety: rollout defaults to conservative probe schedule (0.5% shadow, 30s windows, 3-window quorum) to avoid production impact. The rollout spec supports explicit customer opt-in for more aggressive probing. Backwards compatibility: new fields are optional and ignored by older controllers; routing fallbacks route to stable model if the head variant is incompatible. Related work: builds on ENG-4521 (rollout state machine refactor) and ENG-4590 (routing abstraction); referenced in runbook and Linear tasks. Merge & rollout plan: squash-merge to main; rollout controller feature flag gated for 48 hours then enabled for 5% of accounts, monitor rollout_decision_score and rollback events; full enable after 7 days if no regressions. Notes for on-call: new alerts added for rollout_quarantine_count > 0 and for repeated automatic rollbacks; links to runbook included in runbook doc.
